# Run genomic prediction

## Definition of scenarios

Genomic predictions scenarios:

- **wBP**: within each BP, the nursery being considered as a breeding program here.

- **acBP**: across each pair of BP, the nursery being considered as a breeding program here. The training set is composed of one breeding program. For example, NDSU -> SDSU, NDSU -> URN/URSN, ...We will extract more specifically how well the nursery is predicting the individual breeding program.

- **acAllBP**: across BP but using data from all other breeding program in the training set: NDSU + SDSU + URN/URSN -> MSU for example.

- **nursBP**: training using nursery genotypes from the breeding program to be predicted.

For all the predictions, record the training/validation set size and the genetic relatedness.

Questions:

- Need a better control of training/validation set sizes with resampling?
- Test training set optimization?
- Study the contribution of parameters to the predictive ability?

## Prediction parameters

Cross-validation parameters:
```{r CV_params}
dim(pheno) ## 3270 x 11
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(pheno$GID)))
## params:
ar <- "3k" ## genotypic array
nreps <- 20 ## number of cross-validation repetitions
nfolds <- 10 ## number of cross-validation folds
nIter <- 15000 ## default 6000
burnIn <- 2000 ## default 1000
h <- 1 ## bandwidth parameter for RKHS

nb.cores <- 12
p2d.temp <- here::here("output","genom_pred","temp")
#dir.create(p2d.temp)
stopifnot(dir.exists(p2d.temp)) 
write(p2d.temp,stderr())

## list of possible GP method       
method <- meth<- c("GBLUP")#"RKHS",
suf <- ""
```


## wBP scenario

wBP: within each BP, the nursery being considered as a breeding program here.
```{r apply_gp_all_wBP}
gp.wBP <- data.frame()
rerun=F ## set to FALSE to avoid rerunning genomic prediction
obs.pred <- list()
for(bp in BPs){
  write(paste(bp,"\n"),stderr())
  for(meth in method){
    
    p2f.stats <- here("output","genom_pred",
                      paste0(bp,"_GP_",meth,"_results_intraCV",suf,".tsv"))
    if(!file.exists(p2f.stats) |rerun){
      #write(paste(meth,"\n"),stderr())
      out <- list()
      gid.bp <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% bp]
      genoBP=geno.sc[gid.bp,]
      phenoBP=pheno[match(gid.bp,pheno$GID),]
      ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations
      traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
      
      out[[bp]] <-  compute_GP_methods(geno=genoBP, pheno=phenoBP,
                                       traits=traits.50obs, 
                                       GP.method=meth,
                                       nreps=nreps, nfolds=nfolds, 
                                       p2d.temp=p2d.temp,
                                       h=h,
                                       p2f.stats=p2f.stats, 
                                       nb.cores=nb.cores)
      ## export obs vs. pred
      obs.pred[[bp]] <- purrr::map_dfr(traits, function(x) out[[bp]]$obspred[[x]]) |> 
        mutate(trainSetBP=bp, validSetBP=bp)
      ## record training and validation set BP
      out[[bp]]$gp.stats$trainSetBP <- bp
      out[[bp]]$gp.stats$validSetBP <- bp
      #gp.statsT <- purrr::map_dfr(outT, function(x) x$gp.stats)
      gp.wBP <- plyr::rbind.fill(gp.wBP,out[[bp]]$gp.stats)
      
      ## export observed vs predicted values
      p2f <- here("output","genom_pred",paste0("observed-vs-predicted_wBP_",meth,".rds"))
      saveRDS(obs.pred, p2f)
    } else{
      tmp <- read.table(file=p2f.stats, sep="\t", header=TRUE)
      tmp$trainSetBP <- bp
      tmp$validSetBP <- bp
      gp.wBP <- plyr::rbind.fill(gp.wBP, tmp)
      
    }
  }
}
## aggregate the results, average over the rep
#ap(gp.wBP)
round(tapply(gp.wBP$corP, gp.wBP$trait, mean, na.rm=T),3)
round(tapply(gp.wBP$corP, gp.wBP$trainSetBP, mean, na.rm=T),3)
gp.wBP$scenario <- "wBP"


gp.wBP <- gp.wBP |> 
  group_by(trait, GP.method, scenario, trainSetBP, validSetBP) |> 
  summarize(across(where(is.numeric), mean),.groups="drop") |> 
  dplyr::select(-rep)


# gp.wBP <- gp.wBP |> group_by(trait, GP.method, scenario,BP) |> 
#   summarize(corP=mean(corP, na.rm=T))
```

## acBP scenarios

Training set: each breeding program.
Validation set: each breeding program except the training set.

### Main one

```{r gp_acBP}
df.stats <- expand.grid(trainSet=BPs, validSet=BPs, stringsAsFactors = F)
df.stats <- filter(df.stats, !trainSet == validSet)
gp.acBP <- data.frame()
obs.pred <- list()
rerun=F
for(bp in BPs){
  trainSetBP <- bp
  
  p2f.stats <- here("output","genom_pred",
                    paste0(bp,"-Train_","GP_",
                           meth,"_results_acBP",suf,".tsv"))
  if(!file.exists(p2f.stats) |rerun){
    write(paste(trainSetBP,"training set\n"),stderr())
    ## training set: each individual BP
    gid.train <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% bp]
    gid.valid.all <- pheno$GID[!pheno$BP %in% bp]
    
    genoBP=geno.sc[c(gid.train,gid.valid.all),]
    phenoBP=pheno[match(c(gid.train,gid.valid.all),pheno$GID),]
    
    ## mask the phenotype traits as NA for the validation set
    phenoBP[phenoBP$GID %in% gid.valid.all,traits] <- NA
    ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations 
    traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
    ## subselect traits in the validation set as well
    traits.50obs <- traits.50obs[which(colSums(
      !is.na(pheno[match(gid.valid.all,pheno$GID),traits.50obs])) > 50)]
    
    ## compute genomic prediction
    pred <- compute_GP_allGeno(geno=genoBP, pheno=phenoBP,
                               traits=traits.50obs, 
                               GP.method=meth,
                               runCV=FALSE, 
                               testSetGID=gid.valid.all,
                               nb.cores=nb.cores,
                               p2d.temp=p2d.temp)
    ## calculate the predictive ability
    ### put as long format
    pred.long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(pred, cols=all_of(traits.50obs),
                                     names_to="trait",values_to="pred")
    ### add observed value
    pheno.obs <- pheno |> #filter(BP %in% validSetBP) |> 
      dplyr::select(all_of(c("GID","BP",traits.50obs))) |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=all_of(traits.50obs), 
                          names_to="trait",values_to="obs") %>% 
      mutate(trait=factor(trait, traits.50obs)) %>% 
      filter(!is.na(obs))
    
    ## number of ValidSet genotypes for each trait and BP
    VS.size <- pheno.obs %>% group_by(BP,trait) %>% 
      summarize(n=n(), .groups="drop")
    ## valid set / trait combo to remove if less than 50 obs
    comb2rem <- VS.size %>% filter(n < 50) %>% mutate(trait_BP=paste0(trait,"_",BP))
    ## add BP + obs
    pred.long <- merge(pred.long,pheno.obs, by=c("GID","trait")) 
    
    ## export obs vs pred
    obs.pred[[bp]] <- pred.long
    obs.pred[[bp]]$trainSetBP <- bp
    
    ## calculate the correlation between obs/pred and add statistics
    pred.stats <- pred.long |> 
      group_by(trait,BP) |> 
      summarize(corP=round(cor(obs,pred, use="pairwise.complete.obs"),3),.groups="drop") |> 
      mutate(GP.method=meth,
             trait_BP=paste0(trait,"_",BP)) %>%
      filter(!trait_BP %in% comb2rem$trait_BP) %>% 
      mutate(trainSetBP=trainSetBP,.after=GP.method)  %>% 
      rename(validSetBP=BP) %>% dplyr::select(-trait_BP)
    
    write.table(pred.stats, file=p2f.stats, sep="\t",row.names=F)
    gp.acBP <- rbind(gp.acBP,pred.stats)
    ## save obs vs. pred
    p2f <- here("output","genom_pred",paste0("observed-vs-predicted_acBP_",meth,".rds"))
    saveRDS(obs.pred, p2f)
    
  } else{
    gp.acBP <- plyr::rbind.fill(gp.acBP, 
                                read.table(file=p2f.stats,sep="\t", header=TRUE))
    
  }
}
gp.acBP$scenario <- "acBP"
```


### acBP NUR since specific date

Training set: URN/URSN genotypes since 2005.
Validation set: breeding program.

We are testing if it is useful to add old nursery genotypes to predict the breeding program. 


```{r}
dates <- seq(2000,2020, by=5)
gp.acBP.date <- data.frame()
rerun=F
obs.pred <- list()

for(date in dates){
  write(paste0("since ",date,"\n"), stderr())
  pheno.sinceDate <- pheno |>
    filter(BP %in% "NUR", GID %in% nur.info$GID[nur.info$FIRST_YEAR >= date]) |> 
    bind_rows(pheno |> filter(!BP %in% "NUR"))
  
  df.stats <- expand.grid(trainSet="NUR",stringsAsFactors = F)
  
  trainSetBP <- bp <- "NUR"
  p2f.stats <- here("output","genom_pred",
                    paste0(bp,"-Train_","GP_",
                           meth,"_results_acBP-since",date,suf,".tsv"))
  if(!file.exists(p2f.stats) |rerun){
    ## training set: NUR
    gid.train <- pheno.sinceDate$GID[pheno.sinceDate$BP %in% bp]
    gid.valid.all <- pheno.sinceDate$GID[!pheno.sinceDate$BP %in% bp]
    
    genoBP=geno.sc[c(gid.train,gid.valid.all),]
    phenoBP=pheno.sinceDate[match(c(gid.train,gid.valid.all),pheno.sinceDate$GID),]
    
    ## mask the phenotype traits as NA for the validation set
    phenoBP[phenoBP$GID %in% gid.valid.all,traits] <- NA
    ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations 
    traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
    ## subselect traits in the validation set as well
    traits.50obs <- traits.50obs[which(colSums(
      !is.na(pheno[match(gid.valid.all,pheno$GID),traits.50obs])) > 50)]
    
    ## compute genomic prediction
    pred <- compute_GP_allGeno(geno=genoBP, pheno=phenoBP,
                               traits=traits.50obs, 
                               GP.method=meth,
                               runCV=FALSE, 
                               testSetGID=gid.valid.all,
                               nb.cores=nb.cores,
                               p2d.temp=p2d.temp)
    ## calculate the predictive ability
    ### put as long format
    pred.long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(pred, cols=all_of(traits.50obs),
                                     names_to="trait",values_to="pred")
    ### add observed value
    pheno.obs <- pheno |> #filter(BP %in% validSetBP) |> 
      dplyr::select(all_of(c("GID","BP",traits.50obs))) |>
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=all_of(traits.50obs), 
                          names_to="trait",values_to="obs") %>% 
      mutate(trait=factor(trait, traits.50obs)) %>% 
      filter(!is.na(obs))
    
    ## number of ValidSet genotypes for each trait and BP
    VS.size <- pheno.obs %>% group_by(BP,trait) %>% 
      summarize(n=n(), .groups="drop")
    ## valid set / trait combo to remove if less than 50 obs
    comb2rem <- VS.size %>% filter(n < 50)
    ## add BP + obs
    pred.long <- merge(pred.long,pheno.obs, by=c("GID","trait")) 
    ## export obs vs pred
    obs.pred[[paste0("since",date)]] <- pred.long
    obs.pred[[paste0("since",date)]]$trainSetBP <- paste0("NUR-since",date)
    ## calculate the correlation between obs/pred and add statistics
    pred.stats <- pred.long |> 
      group_by(trait,BP) |> 
      summarize(corP=round(cor(obs,pred, use="pairwise.complete.obs"),3),.groups="drop") |> 
      mutate(GP.method=meth) %>% 
      filter(!(trait %in% comb2rem$trait & BP %in% comb2rem$BP)) %>% 
      mutate(trainSetBP=paste0("NUR-since",date),.after=GP.method,
             scenario="acBP-NUR-sinceDate")  %>% 
      rename(validSetBP=BP) |> 
      mutate(nb.genos.TS=length(gid.train)) |> 
      left_join(VS.size, by=c("validSetBP"="BP","trait")) |> rename(nb.genos.VS=n)
    
    write.table(pred.stats, file=p2f.stats, sep="\t",row.names=F)
    gp.acBP.date <- rbind(gp.acBP.date,pred.stats)
    ## save obs vs. pred
    p2f <- here("output","genom_pred",paste0("observed-vs-predicted_acBP-since",date,"_",meth,".rds"))
    saveRDS(obs.pred, p2f)
  } else{
    gp.acBP.date <- plyr::rbind.fill(gp.acBP.date, 
                                     read.table(file=p2f.stats,sep="\t", header=TRUE))
  }
}

table(gp.acBP.date$trainSetBP)
tapply(gp.acBP.date$corP, gp.acBP.date$trainSetBP, mean)
```

## acAllBP scenario

acAllBP: across BP but using data from all other breeding program in the training set: NDSU + SDSU + URN/URSN -> MSU for example.


```{r gp-acAllBP}
gp.acAllBP <- data.frame()
rerun=F
obs.pred <- list()
for(bp in BPs){
  p2f.stats <- here("output","genom_pred",
                    paste0(bp,"-Valid_GP_",meth,"_results_acAllBP",suf,".tsv"))
  if(!file.exists(p2f.stats) |rerun){
    write(paste(bp,"validation set\n"),stderr())
    ## training set: all other breeding program /data
    gid.train <- pheno$GID[!pheno$BP %in% bp]
    gid.valid <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% bp]
    phenoBP <- pheno; phenoBP[match(gid.valid, pheno$GID),traits] <- NA
    ## mask the phenotype traits as NA for the validation set
    ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations
    traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
    ## subselect traits in the validation set as well
    traits.50obs <- traits.50obs[which(colSums(
      !is.na(pheno[match(gid.valid,pheno$GID),traits.50obs])) > 50)]
    ## compute genomic prediction
    pred <- compute_GP_allGeno(geno=geno.sc, pheno=phenoBP,
                               traits=traits.50obs, 
                               GP.method=meth,
                               runCV=FALSE, 
                               testSetGID=gid.valid,
                               nb.cores=nb.cores,
                               p2d.temp=p2d.temp)
    ## calculate the predictive ability
    ### put as long format
    pred.long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(pred, cols=all_of(traits.50obs),
                                     names_to="trait",values_to="pred")
    ### add observed value
    pheno.obs <- pheno |> filter(GID %in% gid.valid) |> 
      dplyr::select(all_of(c("GID",traits.50obs))) |> 
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=all_of(traits.50obs), 
                          names_to="trait",values_to="obs") %>% 
      mutate(trait=factor(trait, traits.50obs))
    
    ## calculate genetic relatedness btw training and validation set
    ## get the list of training and validation set genotypes by trait
    gid.train.tr <- apply(phenoBP[,traits.50obs],2,\(x) phenoBP$GID[!is.na(x)])
    gid.valid.tr <- split(pheno.obs, pheno.obs$trait)
    gid.valid.tr <- lapply(gid.valid.tr, \(x) unique(x$GID[!is.na(x$obs)]))
    stopifnot(identical(names(gid.train.tr),names(gid.valid.tr)))
    
    pred.long <- merge(pred.long,pheno.obs)
    ## export obs vs pred
    obs.pred[[bp]] <- pred.long
    obs.pred[[bp]]$validSetBP <- bp
    ## calculate the correlation between obs/pred and add statistics
    pred.stats <- pred.long |> group_by(trait) |> 
      summarize(corP=round(cor(obs,pred, use="pairwise.complete.obs"),3),
                GP.method=meth,
                nb.genos.VS=length(na.omit(obs))) |> 
      mutate(validSetBP=bp,.after=GP.method) |> 
      bind_cols(nb.genos.TS=c(sapply(gid.train.tr,length))) 
    
    write.table(pred.stats, file=p2f.stats, sep="\t",row.names=F)
    gp.acAllBP <- rbind(gp.acAllBP,pred.stats)
    ## save obs vs pred
    p2f <- here("output","genom_pred",paste0("observed-vs-predicted_acAllBP_",meth,".rds"))
    saveRDS(obs.pred, p2f)
  } else{
    gp.acAllBP <- rbind(gp.acAllBP, read.table(file=p2f.stats, sep="\t", header=TRUE))
    
  }
}
gp.acAllBP$scenario <- "acAllBP"
print_table(gp.acAllBP)

```






## nursBP scenario

nursBP: training using nursery genotypes from the breeding program to be predicted.

```{r gp-nursBP}
gp.nursBP <- data.frame()
rerun=F
obs.pred <- list()
for(bp in BPs[!BPs %in% "NUR"]){
  p2f.stats <- here("output","genom_pred",
                    paste0(bp,"-Valid_GP_",meth,"_results_nursBP",suf,".tsv"))
  if(!file.exists(p2f.stats) |rerun){
    write(paste(bp,"validation set\n"),stderr())
    ## validation set: each individual BP (no nursery)
    gid.valid <- pheno$GID[pheno$BP %in% bp]
    ## training set: each individual BP
    gid.train <- intersect(gid.nur, nur.info$GID[nur.info$SOURCE %in% bp])
    phenoBP <- pheno[match(c(gid.train, gid.valid), pheno$GID),] 
    phenoBP[match(gid.valid, phenoBP$GID),traits] <- NA
    genoBP <- geno.sc[c(gid.train, gid.valid),]
    ## mask the phenotype traits as NA for the validation set
    ## select the set of traits with more than 50 observations
    traits.50obs <- traits[which(colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits])) > 50)]
    ## subselect traits in the validation set as well
    traits.50obs <- traits.50obs[which(colSums(
      !is.na(pheno[match(gid.valid,pheno$GID),traits.50obs])) > 50)]
    ## training set size
    nb.genos.TS <- tibble(trait=traits.50obs,
                          nb.genos.TS=colSums(!is.na(phenoBP[,traits.50obs])))
    
    ## compute genomic prediction
    pred <- compute_GP_allGeno(geno=genoBP, pheno=phenoBP,
                               traits=traits.50obs, 
                               GP.method=meth,
                               runCV=FALSE, 
                               testSetGID=gid.valid,
                               nb.cores=nb.cores,
                               p2d.temp=p2d.temp)
    ## calculate the predictive ability
    ### put as long format
    pred.long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(pred, cols=all_of(traits.50obs),
                                     names_to="trait",values_to="pred")
    ### add observed value
    pheno.obs <- pheno |> filter(BP %in% bp) |> 
      dplyr::select(all_of(c("GID",traits.50obs))) |> 
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=all_of(traits.50obs), 
                          names_to="trait",values_to="obs") %>% 
      mutate(trait=factor(trait, traits.50obs))
    ## calculate genetic relatedness btw training and validation set
    ## get the list of training and validation set genotypes by trait
    gid.train.tr <- apply(phenoBP[,traits.50obs],2,\(x) phenoBP$GID[!is.na(x)])
    gid.valid.tr <- split(pheno.obs, pheno.obs$trait)
    gid.valid.tr <- lapply(gid.valid.tr, \(x) unique(x$GID[!is.na(x$obs)]))
    stopifnot(identical(names(gid.train.tr),names(gid.valid.tr)))
    # summ.rel <- map2_dfr(gid.train.tr, gid.valid.tr, 
    #                      \(x,y) summary(c(GRM[x,y]))[c(1,3,4,6)]) %>% 
    #   bind_cols(trait=names(gid.train.tr))
    # 
    pred.long <- merge(pred.long,pheno.obs)
    ## export obs vs pred
    obs.pred[[bp]] <- pred.long
    obs.pred[[bp]]$validSetBP <- bp
    ## calculate the correlation between obs/pred and add statistics
    pred.stats <- pred.long |> group_by(trait) |> 
      summarize(corP=round(cor(obs,pred, use="pairwise.complete.obs"),3),
                GP.method=meth,
                nb.genos.VS=length(na.omit(obs))) |> 
      mutate(validSetBP=bp,.after=GP.method) |>
      bind_cols(nb.genos.TS=c(sapply(gid.train.tr,length)))# %>% 
    #left_join(summ.rel, by="trait")
    #left_join(nb.genos.TS, by="trait")
    
    write.table(pred.stats, file=p2f.stats, sep="\t",row.names=F)
    gp.nursBP <- rbind(gp.nursBP,pred.stats)
    ## save obs vs pred
    p2f <- here("output","genom_pred",paste0("observed-vs-predicted_nursBP_",meth,".rds"))
    saveRDS(obs.pred, p2f)
  } else{
    gp.nursBP <- plyr::rbind.fill(gp.nursBP, 
                                  read.table(file=p2f.stats, sep="\t", header=TRUE))
    
  }
}
gp.nursBP$scenario <- "nursBP"

```
